versionRationale: Authored deterministic capacity corpus. Counts and outcomes derive from existing contracts, not response snapshots. Q1 defines 64 MiB TXT ingest as sixteen sequential 4 MiB documents. Digest changes require a new version and behavioral rationale. Version 1.1.0 binds large prefilter to the existing QueryGrant maximum of 4096 allowed source versions over the unchanged 10000-source/100000-chunk corpus; a 4097-entry grant must fail. The reference corpus alternates equal-byte EN and RU texts and preserves exact IR/span digests. Version 1.2.0 adds query-plan counterfactuals after full-scale loading exposed tenant scans in exact block and snapshot-member guards. Additive migration 012 indexes the existing predicates without changing their semantics. Version 1.3.0 binds a valid reference index manifest above 1 MiB to the existing 16 MiB schema ceiling, and adds the above-16-MiB negative boundary. The generic JSON default was not the approved index-manifest contract. Version 1.4.0 removes only a redundant legacy 4 MiB persistence guard discovered on full manifest sealing; the existing 16 MiB SQL guard remains. Positive SQL above 4 MiB and negative SQL above 16 MiB test the same approved wire ceiling. Version 1.5.0 adds changed-bytes/digest and post-cache committed-revoke negatives after the fixed 20-client workload measured warm p95 above the unchanged 500 ms target. A single-entry immutable validation cache preserves authoritative per-request checks.
origin: Project-authored TXT generator and synthetic catalog identities; existing project-authored retrieval/scanned PDF fixtures bound by the group manifest.
